intro.text: The ten fools are figures of Vorin tradition, invoked to describe someone behaving very foolishly.
The ten fools are figures of Vorin tradition, each standing for a particular kind of folly, invoked to describe someone behaving very foolishly.

description.text: Cabine is a grown man who behaves like a child.
Eshu lectures people about subjects they know and he does not.
Dilid ran up a hillside of shifting sand toward the Tranquiline Halls forever, never getting any closer.
Each fool stands for one foolish trait, which has its own glyph known to Vorin ardents. People name a particular fool, either by name or by number, such as the "fourth fool", to stress that trait.

items.text: Pai made a bold protest against Queen Aesudan and the Alethi government by invoking the ten fools.
